contact.title: Contact
contact.blurb: Email is the fastest way to reach me. I'm also on GitHub and LinkedIn.

labels.footer: Built with React, Vite and Tailwind CSS.
labels.privacy: Privacy: the chat assistant keeps your conversation only in this browser tab. The server logs the questions asked, with no IP address or other identifier, and deletes them after 90 days. No cookies.

twin.title: Ask my twin
twin.disclosure: I'm an AI assistant trained on Anurag's portfolio. I can be wrong.
suggestions: What did you do at your internship?
How did you handle class imbalance in the intrusion detection project?
Which of your projects used Gemini?

errors.rate_limited: You've sent a lot of questions in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.daily_cap: The twin has hit its limit for today. Try again tomorrow, or email me at {email}.
errors.upstream: Something went wrong on my side. Please try again, or email me at {email}.
errors.bad_request: That message couldn't be sent. Keep it under 500 characters and try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

twinCta.title: Questions about my work? Ask the twin.
twinCta.text: It answers from the content on this page only, links each answer to the section it came from, and tells you when it doesn't know.
